settings.title: You're invited into our world.
settings.subtitle: Herprint was built by women, for women. Whether you create, lead, or dream — there is a place for you here.

settings.title: Free Experience
settings.text: Receive a Herprint coupon to shop our collection, completely on us.

settings.title: No Obligation
settings.text: We ask nothing in return. If you love it and want to share, we'd be honoured.

settings.title: Ongoing Partnership
settings.text: Great fits become long-term Herprint friends — with early access, custom pieces, and more.
Have 10,000+ followers on any single platform
Create in fashion, beauty, lifestyle or jewelry
Are active on YouTube, Instagram or TikTok

settings.title: For the creators who move culture.
settings.lead: If you create content around fashion, beauty, lifestyle or jewelry — and your community trusts you — we want to gift you a Herprint experience. No strings. Just jewelry that fits your story.

settings.title: Build with Us
settings.text: Join our core team as a regional partner, brand ambassador or creative collaborator.

settings.title: Grow Together
settings.text: Access resources, mentorship and a global network of women who lift each other up.

settings.title: Make an Impact
settings.text: A portion of every sale goes into our fund — supporting children and single mothers worldwide.

settings.title: For the ambitious women ready to build something real.
settings.lead: We are looking for driven, passionate women around the world to grow with us. Herprint is not just a jewelry brand — it is a movement.

settings.label: The Herprint Fund
settings.title: We are building a real fund for children and single mothers around the world.
settings.text: Because every woman deserves a chance. And every child deserves a future. This is what Herprint is ultimately for.
